purpose: Organize a portfolio of operational objects by work stage while preserving owner, age, next action, and exception visibility.

useWhen: people manage many work items waiting in human-action stages
stage balance, age, ownership, and WIP visibility drive daily coordination
avoidWhen: the surface follows one object's ordered lifecycle
stable cross-record comparison is better served by a DataTable

responsive.desktop: Use bounded stage columns with scan-first cards and visible column headings.
responsive.tablet: Allow horizontal board scrolling only when columns retain readable width.
responsive.mobile: Prefer a stage-by-stage stacked sequence or explicit stage switcher over miniature columns.

accessibility: Expose every column with a heading and count.
Preserve a logical DOM order independent of visual placement.
Do not make drag-and-drop the only way to change or inspect work.
operational.aiGuidance: Choose Operational Kanban for many work items awaiting people; do not use it for the lifecycle of one object.
antiPatterns: Using color alone for stage or exception state
